The market is flooded with all sorts of MagSafe chargers, and I probably already own most of them. Recently, this new TESSAN AERO 5000 caught my eye because it's incredibly thin and features a titanium shell. It also incorporates new battery technology that reduces heat generation and improves overall safety. After going through the full spec sheet, I think it could be one of the more notable MagSafe battery products this year, and I can't wait to try it out for myself.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers provides in-depth analysis of the latest news in MagSafe and wireless charging to help you get the most out of your wireless charging-compatible Apple devices.

Titanium body with an ultra-thin design

TESSAN designed the AERO 5000 to be only 6.9mm thick, roughly equivalent to three credit cards stacked together. Its design allows it to slip easily into your pocket without feeling like a thick battery pack in your pants pocket—it feels just like carrying a MagSafe wallet.

Beyond the size, it's the choice of shell material that makes this product stand out. TESSAN used iPhone-grade titanium alloy as the battery backplate, a rather refined design. Battery products like this are generally difficult to differentiate, usually competing on price or capacity.

For the battery, TESSAN adopted a pure cobalt semi-solid-state cell called SolidSafe. Traditional batteries typically contain highly flammable liquid, whereas TESSAN's new structure significantly reduces heat buildup and can prevent thermal runaway even if the battery suffers severe physical impact. Heat is the enemy of battery health, so any design that lowers temperatures during charging is a major advantage. It can deliver up to 15W wireless output, or 20W via the USB-C port. Even with a small-capacity battery, the wired output port is very practical (you can use it to charge AirPods, for example).

TESSAN AERO 5000 summary

If you want your everyday carry to be as lightweight as possible, the TESSAN AERO 5000 looks like an excellent choice. It combines a titanium shell with next-generation battery safety technology to effectively manage heat issues.

To learn more about the TESSAN AERO 5000, visit Tessan's official website
